description: Delete one or more folder-level referrers by id (batch). Duplicate ids are de-duplicated; if any id is missing the API returns 404, and if any referrer is library-level it returns 400 ({ errCode, errMsg }). Rows transition to 'deleting' and are removed asynchronously.

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

name: panda_delete_folder_refer
title: Delete Folder Domain Referrers
